steps.en: Staff sign in and reach ACM if they have ACM access.
steps.id: Staff login dan masuk ke ACM kalau punya akses ACM.
steps.why_en: Portal login is outside this code; the mapping action itself is not tied to a signed-in user behind the scenes.
steps.why_id: Login portal di luar code ini; aksi mapping sendiri tidak terikat ke user yang login di balik layar.

steps.en: Only admins see the User Role Mapping menu.
steps.id: Hanya admin yang melihat menu User Role Mapping.
steps.why_en: The check exists only in the screen; the system behind the screen does not verify the admin role.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan hanya di layar; sistem di balik layar tidak memverifikasi role admin.

steps.en: The screen lists all active users with their details.
steps.id: Layar menampilkan semua user aktif beserta datanya.

steps.en: Staff can search and export the user list; sorting is unconfirmed.
steps.id: Staff bisa search dan export daftar user; sort belum terbukti.
steps.why_en: Search matches more fields than ID and name, and column sorting was not found.
steps.why_id: Search mencocokkan lebih banyak field dari ID dan nama, dan sort kolom tidak ditemukan.

steps.en: Clicking edit opens the role form for that user.
steps.id: Klik edit membuka form role untuk user itu.

steps.en: The form lets staff choose roles, an approver and a supporter.
steps.id: Form memungkinkan staff memilih role, approver, dan supporter.

steps.en: Approver and supporter must differ and not be the requester.
steps.id: Approver dan supporter harus berbeda dan bukan pengaju.
steps.why_en: The requester is only filtered out of the dropdowns; the system behind the screen does not block self-selection.
steps.why_id: Pengaju hanya disaring dari dropdown; sistem di balik layar tidak memblokir pilih diri sendiri.

steps.en: Submitting creates a pending request for the supporter and approver.
steps.id: Submit membuat request pending untuk supporter dan approver.

steps.en: Removing a role takes effect immediately without approval.
steps.id: Pencabutan role langsung berlaku tanpa persetujuan.
steps.why_en: Only added roles wait for approval; removed roles are deleted at once.
steps.why_id: Hanya role yang ditambah menunggu persetujuan; role yang dicabut langsung dihapus.

steps.en: The supporter gets an email when a request is submitted.
steps.id: Supporter dapat email saat request diajukan.

steps.en: A popup appears when a request fails, with a general message.
steps.id: Popup muncul saat request gagal, dengan pesan umum.
steps.why_en: The message is generic and some failure statuses show no popup.
steps.why_id: Pesannya umum dan beberapa status gagal tidak memunculkan popup.

steps.en: Staff can only manage roles for their own application.
steps.id: Staff hanya bisa mengatur role untuk aplikasinya sendiri.
steps.why_en: No such restriction exists; all roles are offered to every admin.
steps.why_id: Pembatasan itu tidak ada; semua role ditawarkan ke setiap admin.
